name: Hallowed Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, a young dwarf priest is called to Anvilmar by Sten Stoutarm. He carries Branstock Khalder’s inscribed prayers and guidance to the novice, who is summoned inside to deepen their bond with the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Calling to the Cloth
sections.body: A young priest earns Sten Stoutarm’s notice while helping clear threats outside Anvilmar. Branstock Khalder, the settlement’s spiritual guide, gives Sten a rune inscribed with prayers and guidance for the novice. Then the young priest is called inside Anvilmar’s sturdy halls to begin sacred studies.

sections.title: Defenders of Coldridge
sections.body: Dwarven life prizes martial strength and heavy plate, yet the Holy Light remains central to Ironforge society. In Coldridge Valley, holy casters stand with warriors and hunters to protect the enclave from trogg incursions and dangerous wildlife moving through the snow.

faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm gives the inscribed clerical rune on Branstock Khalder’s behalf. Its prayers introduce young priests to the faith and guide them toward formal training.
Branstock Khalder trains dwarven priests inside Anvilmar. His dry humor and steadfast faith guide new acolytes as he teaches the foundational Holy spells used to defend Coldridge Valley.

faq.q: Where do I find Branstock Khalder?
faq.answer: Branstock Khalder is inside Anvilmar’s main stone lodge, in the central clearing of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why do dwarves need priests in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun parts of the valley. Guards rely on priests to heal the wounded and wield the Light against their foes as they hold their lines.

faq.q: Can any class take this quest?
faq.answer: No. Only young dwarf priests beginning their journey in Coldridge Valley receive the Hallowed Rune.

faq.q: Who delivers the rune to the player?
faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm delivers the rune. He is an Anvilmar mountaineer who oversees trials outside the lodge and gives it to you after you help defend the early valley.

angles.text: As a priest, this rune marks your formal recognition as a servant of the Holy Light in Dun Morogh and sends you to Branstock Khalder for your first spellcraft.
As a dwarf, you join devotion to the Light with mountain grit and help hold Coldridge Valley against invading troggs.
